content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I hope you’re well. Before signing, I would like to suggest a couple of adjustments to the agreement:
- The relevant clause currently states “Invoices are payable Net 90.” This would require waiting up to 90 days for payment, which could strain cash flow. I propose changing it to “Invoices are payable Net 30.”
- The relevant clause also reads “Payment period: Net 90.” This lengthens the payment window beyond the typical 30‑day term and adds cash‑flow risk. I suggest revising it to “Payment period: Net 30 days.”

Thank you for considering these updates. I look forward to moving ahead.

Best regards,
